next_meeting.note: Under way on 2026-11-16. Türkiye holds the COP31 presidency; Australia leads negotiations.

summary.en: COP31 runs 9-20 November 2026 in Antalya with Türkiye as president and Australia leading negotiations; climate finance for adaptation is one of the key disputes.
summary.zh: COP31於2026年11月9日至20日在安塔利亞舉行，由土耳其擔任主席、澳洲主導談判；調適資金是主要爭議之一。

question.en: Who should pay for poorer countries to adapt to climate change?
question.zh: 誰應該為較貧窮國家適應氣候變遷買單？

title.en: Race to choose the next Secretary-General
title.zh: 下一任聯合國秘書長遴選

summary.en: The Security Council is holding straw polls to pick Guterres's successor; Costa Rica's Rebeca Grynspan led the fourth poll in late September 2026.
summary.zh: 安理會正以非正式投票遴選古特瑞斯的繼任者；哥斯大黎加的葛林斯潘在2026年9月底第四輪投票中領先。

question.en: Should the five permanent members be able to veto the choice of Secretary-General?
question.zh: 五個常任理事國是否應有權否決秘書長人選？

text.en: UN Charter signed in San Francisco; UN founded with 51 members
text.zh: 舊金山簽署《聯合國憲章》，51國創立聯合國

text.en: Universal Declaration of Human Rights adopted

text.zh: 第2758號決議：中華人民共和國取得中國席位

text.en: Rio Earth Summit creates climate convention (UNFCCC)
text.zh: 里約地球高峰會訂立氣候公約
南蘇丹成為第193個會員國

text.en: Sustainable Development Goals and Paris Agreement adopted
text.zh: 通過永續發展目標與《巴黎協定》
